instruction.text: Choose the correct meaning of the words.

b.sound: An opinion is what a person thinks about something.
An opinion is when a person says something wrong.
An ability is something that a person is good at.
An ability is something that a person likes.
Someone’s personality determines how they usually respond to a situation.
Someone’s personality is the measure of how clever they are.

instruction.text: Read the text and decide what sort of difference there is.

atoms.a: Hanna doesn’t want to go to the party because loud and crowded places overwhelm her. Janice thrives in busy places with lots of people and wants to go.
Ahmad doesn’t like potatoes, but his brother enjoys them very much.
Alaina thinks superhero films are better, but James disagrees. He thinks romantic comedies are better.
Tim isn’t very good at maths, so he often asks Maria for help. In return, he helps her with her science homework.
Henry is very adventurous and likes to explore new things. His sister finds exploring stressful.
Will is a great cook and likes hosting dinner parties. His brother, James, is not a good cook, so he often helps out by carrying stuff around or chopping ingredients instead.
